name: Shindan no Kekka, Sore wa Koi no Yamai Desu
original_name: 診断の結果、それは恋の病です
source:
Tatsuya is a NEET otaku living in Tokyo. One day Tatsuya and his older sister Rikka, who’s a doctor, travel to a small village in Hokkaido to work at a clinic for a short time. There he meets Nana, a nurse who has likewise come to the clinic as a temp worker.

-Description edited from Hau~ Omochikaeri!
translation:
达也是住在东京的无业宅男。某天，他与身为医生的姐姐立夏前往北海道的一座小村庄，暂时在当地诊所工作。在那里，他遇见了同样作为临时工来到诊所的护士菜菜。

[据Hau~ Omochikaeri!编辑]
